headline: Bank of England hikes interest rate for the first time since Iran war, warns inflation will near 5%
detail: Central bank tightening signals a less favorable environment for growth stocks and can increase borrowing costs, impacting margin accounts. Higher rates generally pressure tech valuations, which dominate your portfolio.
rec: This reinforces a cautious stance on your tech-heavy, margin-fueled portfolio. No specific trade, but be aware of broader market headwinds.

headline: An Anthropic IPO when the AI trade is this turbulent? Godspeed!
detail: This headline directly points to significant turbulence and risk within the AI sector. Given your concentration in tech/chip names, this is a clear warning for positions like SMCI, SNOW, and leveraged tech ETFs.
rec: Consider trimming positions in leveraged tech/AI names like SMCI, METU, or PLTU to reduce exposure to this turbulent sector, especially given your margin.
